Calcs: Aerodactyl Rock Slide 7-11.5%/hit vs Hippowdon (never KOs); Kingambit Iron Head 2x SE vs Aerodactyl ~50%; burned Kowtow/Sucker OHKO low-HP Mega Gengar. Kingambit walls Mega Gengar. Sleep = 1-2 full turns unable to act, cured the turn after; Protect does NOT prevent Yawn sleep at end of turn. Hippowdon solo-stalls Aerodactyl: Yawn on wake turns, Slack Off on sleep turns only when chipped, immune HHP as default free pass; never waste Yawn/Slack Off PP. G1 endgame confirmed: Aerodactyl abandoned Rock Slide and only chained Tailwind (even into active Tailwind)/Protect/Wide Guard—opponent never adapts to stall; HP lead wins on timer. Shadow Tag traps my pair while Gengar lives. Tendencies: opens Gengar+Aerodactyl, rotates Dragonite+Empoleon mid; WoW on physical threats; chains Protect/status even in lost endgames. G2 plan: same sand lead with Gyarados/Kingambit back; watch for anti-stall tech (Taunt, Arcanine WoW chip) and Clefable.

decisions.rationale: High Horsepower cannot damage Flying-type Aerodactyl and Sandstorm does not affect Rock-types. Aerodactyl will fall asleep at the end of this turn from Yawn, preserving PP during sleep turns while Hippowdon continues consuming PP each turn. Wide Guard conserves Protect PP and Protect success chance for when Hippowdon is eventually forced to Struggle.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Hippowdon't only attacking move is High Horsepower, to which Aerodactyl is immune. Hippowdon cannot damage Aerodactyl by any means short of eventual Struggle recoil. Using Wide Guard conserves PP from our highest remaining PP pool while Aerodactyl is asleep.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Aerodactyl has 0 PP on Rock Slide and Hippowdon cannot damage Flying-type Aerodactyl with Ground moves. If Aerodactyl wakes up this turn, Protect blocks Yawn to prevent immediate re-sleeping while preserving PP across remaining moves.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Aerodactyl is immune to High Horsepower and Hippowdon has no direct damaging moves against Flying types. Aerodactyl is currently asleep and cannot deal direct damage with Rock Slide out of PP. If Aerodactyl wakes up this turn, Protect is safe and preserves 100% success rate while Hippowdon spends PP.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Hippowdon is out of PP and forced to use Struggle. Tailwind and Wide Guard provide zero defensive utility against Struggle. Protect is on reduced success chance (~33%), but if it succeeds, Aerodactyl takes 0 damage while Hippowdon suffers 25% recoil; if Protect fails, the outcome is identical to using any other move.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Gengar into a Sand Rush core (Hippowdon + Excadrill) surrendered offensive pressure early, allowing Hippowdon to isolate Aerodactyl and stall out the game with Yawn and Slack Off.
reflections.adjustment: Pivot away from relying on Mega Gengar against Sand Rush; lead Empoleon to exert immediate Water STAB pressure on Hippowdon and Excadrill before getting dragged into a late-game stall.
